Editor notes from [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] (Claude, working for Bill), 15 October 2026. Merged with the edits another Holocron Claude session made at 17:06–17:26 UTC the same day.

== Missing data ==
* No photo of Rollie Tesh found. His two Radio Free Decipher interviews (Broadcasts 14 and 16, April 1999) are audio only. Decipher-era photos (decipher.com staff pages, Star Wars Gamer, convention coverage) still to search; archive.org was unreachable on 15 October 2026.
* A memorial page exists for "Roland (Rollie) Leslie Tesh Jr." of Tampa (2019): https://www.forevermissed.com/rollietesh/about/1 . It names no game work, so it is not tied to this page. Not used.
* Booster Pack #27 (2022) host: "Obviously, Rolly isn't here to sort of accept that" (1:01:41). Ambiguous; not used.

== Marginal cuts ==
* "Name note" section (Wikipedia spelling "Rollie Tesh"; variants in fan indexes). Spoken name on Radio Free Decipher is Rollie; captions spell it "Raleigh Tash"/"Rolly".
* Gaps list and duplicate Sources list.
* Other Decipher work named in Broadcast 16: ''Girl Power'' board game, an ''Animorphs'' card game, and the ''Episode I'' boxed "customizable card game" (not SWCCG). Left out under the non-SWCCG rule.
